{"task":"derive_control_dae","difficulty":"medium","control_units":["dq PI current controller","omega*L decoupling","R+sL plant","DC-voltage outer PI","active-power outer PI","frequency outer PI","reactive-power outer PI","AC-voltage outer PI","reference limiters"],"inputs":["i_d_ref_inner","i_q_ref_inner","u_sd","u_sq","omega","U_dc_ref","U_dc","P_s_ref","P_s","f_ref","f","Q_s_ref","Q_s","U_s_ref","U_s"],"states":["xi_id","xi_iq","i_d","i_q","xi_A","xi_R","xi_f"],"outputs":["v_d_ref","v_q_ref","i_d_ref","i_q_ref","P_ref"],"differential_equations":["d(xi_id)/dt=i_d_ref_inner-i_d","d(xi_iq)/dt=i_q_ref_inner-i_q","L*d(i_d)/dt=u_sd-v_d_ref-omega*L*i_q-R*i_d","L*d(i_q)/dt=u_sq-v_q_ref+omega*L*i_d-R*i_q","d(xi_A)/dt=e_A","d(xi_R)/dt=e_R","d(xi_f)/dt=f_ref-f"],"algebraic_equations":["v_d_ref=u_sd-K_p*(i_d_ref_inner-i_d)-K_i*xi_id-omega*L*i_q","v_q_ref=u_sq-K_p*(i_q_ref_inner-i_q)-K_i*xi_iq+omega*L*i_d","e_A=U_dc_ref-U_dc if m_A=DC; e_A=P_s_ref-P_s if m_A=P","e_R=Q_s_ref-Q_s if m_R=Q; e_R=U_s_ref-U_s if m_R=U","i_d_ref=sat(K_pA*e_A+K_iA*xi_A,i_d_min,i_d_max)","i_q_ref=sat(K_pR*e_R+K_iR*xi_R,i_q_min,i_q_max)","P_ref=sat(K_pf*(f_ref-f)+K_if*xi_f,P_min,P_max)"],"notes":"m_A in {DC,P} and m_R in {Q,U} are fixed configuration parameters. xi_A,xi_R are the selected outer PI error integrals; xi_f is the separate frequency-error integral. xi_id,xi_iq and i_d,i_q are inner PI/current states. i_d_ref_inner,i_q_ref_inner are independent upper-panel inputs, distinct from lower-panel outputs i_d_ref,i_q_ref; P_ref is distinct from P_s_ref. K_p,K_i are inner gains; K_pA,K_iA,K_pR,K_iR,K_pf,K_if are outer gains.
